architecture.mechanism: Spatiotemporal similarity-based averaging — grouping measurement units (voxels) that exhibit similar dynamic behavior and averaging them to suppress noise while preserving true dynamic signal.
architecture.intervention: Apply a 4D-similarity-filter-style algorithm to the parked Rogue's battery thermal sensor array: register each cell's temperature time series, cluster cells with similar dynamic thermal trajectories, and average within-cluster readings to denoise; cells whose trajectory deviates from all similarity clusters are flagged as anomalous hot spots, triggering a parked-vehicle alert (e.g., app notification or local alarm) independent of dashboard warning lights.
architecture.expected_effect: Reduced thermal-sensor noise on parked vehicles reveals subtle, localized temperature excursions (early thermal-runaway precursors) that raw single-sensor readings mask, enabling fire-risk detection during parking without reliance on prior warning lights.
architecture.falsification_test: Instrument a parked 2020 Rogue battery pack with cell-level thermistors; inject a controlled low-power heater into one cell to produce a sub-threshold temperature drift (~1–2 °C above ambient drift) while logging raw and 4DSF-processed data; the mechanism is falsified if the similarity-filtered output does not isolate the heated cell and raise an alert significantly earlier (e.g., ≥5 minutes) and at lower temperature rise than fixed-threshold detection on raw data.
